title: Villa Paradise | Scenic Stays
meta_description: Nothing but blue skies ahead at Villa Paradise, a magnificent Mediterranean-style home located in a private gated community in Miramar Beach! description_expanded: Nothing but blue skies ahead at Villa Paradise, a magnificent Mediterranean-style home located in a private gated community in Miramar Beach! Just off of beautiful Scenic Gulf Drive, you can walk to the beach and restaurants or just relax by the community pool. There’s no end to the fun you can have in Miramar Beach! Villa Paradise is a gorgeous three-story villa-style home with four bedrooms and two and a half baths accommodating up to ten. Beautifully furnished and fully appointed, this stunning home beckons you into the expansive space to experience the ultimate in luxury living. Beautiful tile floors, high ceilings, and impeccable finishes all enhance the design, intentionally fashioned for comfort, relaxation, and leisure. Living and dining areas are expansive, and a sizeable kitchen designed for entertaining features upgraded appliances, plenty of cabinetry, lots of counter space, and a breakfast bar with seating for three. Expansive windows flood the living room with natural light, and with three sofas, you’ll find more than enough room to stretch out and relax in front of the flat-screen TV. Gather together for sunsets in the evening and share stories of the day on one of the three balconies. A grand staircase leads to luxurious bedrooms and bathrooms with beautiful details and thoughtful finishes, each a welcome retreat after days spent exploring. With two king-sized beds, two queen-sized beds, and two sleeper sofas, everyone’s assured a peaceful night’s sleep. A full-sized washer and dryer are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay! Hang out at the tropical lagoon pool, or walk to the sugar-white shores and soak up that Florida sunshine. You’ll find plenty of shopping nearby at the Silver Sands Outlet Mall, the Destin Commons, and the Market Shops at Sandestin. Find delicious seafood at Tuscany Italian Bistro and Ocean Club Restaurant or opt for an ice-cold beer beachside at the Whale’s Tail, just minutes away. Every day is a reason to celebrate in Miramar Beach! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation of these rules are subject to eviction with no refund.
